source.note: Sampled from Warcraft Logs character rankings, which contain ranked parses only. A kill logged privately, or one Warcraft Logs declined to rank, is not in that list at any depth and no setting here reaches it.
source.evidence: A harvested build is evidence that a real player killed this encounter at this difficulty with it. It is not evidence that the build is optimal, nor that it would still be chosen after a tuning pass.

queries.note: Request counts, not points. Two report-level queries per sampled kill regardless of how many players are wanted from it: playerDetails returns the whole raid, and every actor's talent code is aliased into one request. What that costs in points is read back from rateLimitData in `cost`.
